mapper.select: SELECT r.*, v.voucher_no, v.status AS voucher_status, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.sales_amount), 0) FROM fin_material_cost m WHERE m.period = r.period) AS sales_cost, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.finished_amount), 0) FROM fin_wo_cost w WHERE w.period = r.period) AS finished_cost, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.wip_close), 0) FROM fin_wo_cost w WHERE w.period = r.period) AS wip_cost FROM fin_cost_run r LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = r.voucher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by ORDER BY r.period DESC
